title: PhiJEPA: Denoising Latent Predictions for Visual Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a predictor trained to infer hidden image regions still help a world model plan when part of an object disappears from view and the visible context is blurred? We introduce PhiJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that adapts PhiNet's two-stage prediction to masked Transformers. From sparse, photometrically corrupted context, a Transformer block predicts hidden tokens of an independently corrupted teacher view. A token-wise MLP then maps these predictions to clean teacher tokens. Controlled ablations show that the combined objective improves dense features over the tested one-stage alternatives. Pre-trained on ImageNet-1K with $5.6\times10^{19}$ training FLOPs, PhiJEPA achieves 69.3 mIoU on linear PASCAL VOC segmentation, exceeding the evaluated I-JEPA and DSeq-JEPA checkpoints in segmentation accuracy, with 25\% fewer training FLOPs than I-JEPA. translated_title: PhiJEPA：用于视觉表征学习的去噪潜在预测
translated_abstract: 一个被训练用于推断图像隐藏区域的预测器，能否在物体部分从视野中消失且可见上下文变得模糊时，仍然帮助世界模型进行规划？我们提出了PhiJEPA，这是一种联合嵌入预测架构，将PhiNet的两阶段预测方式适配到掩码Transformer中。从稀疏的、经过光度损坏的上下文中，一个Transformer块预测独立损坏的教师视图的隐藏token。随后，一个逐token的MLP将这些预测映射到干净的教师token。受控消融实验表明，该组合目标在密集特征方面优于所测试的单阶段替代方案。在ImageNet-1K上以5.6×10^19训练FLOPs进行预训练后，PhiJEPA在线性PASCAL VOC分割任务上达到69.3 mIoU，在分割精度上超过了所评估的I-JEPA和DSeq-JEPA检查点，且训练FLOPs比I-JEPA减少25%。它还在隐藏区域分割方面优于Simple I-JEPA（49.1 vs. 44…）。
tldr: PhiJEPA提出了一种两阶段去噪潜在预测架构，由Transformer从损坏上下文预测掩码教师视图的隐藏token、再由逐token的MLP将其映射到干净token，在ImageNet-1K上预训练后在PASCAL VOC线性分割中达到69.3 mIoU，超越I-JEPA和DSeq-JEPA且训练计算量减少25%。
en_tdlr: PhiJEPA introduces a two-stage denoising latent prediction architecture in which a Transformer predicts hidden tokens of an independently corrupted teacher view from sparse photometrically corrupted context and a token-wise MLP maps them to clean teacher tokens, achieving 69.3 mIoU on linear PASCAL VOC segmentation after ImageNet-1K pre-training while outperforming I-JEPA and DSeq-JEPA with 25% fewer training FLOPs.
